title: Deeper/broader cross-project issue lineage and local-gate reconciliation
mode: primary-source web research, local source/test audit, and one existing-harness fast-slice update
scope: Refresh open-source DWG/DXF peer issue reports across parsing, writing, graph closure, strings, and 3D carriers
Separate peer issue claims from normative format evidence and local defect reproduction
Reconcile reports with existing local tests and implementation owners
Strengthen the existing DWG sample harness terminal group-0 EOF check without adding a test registration

method.kind: Primary-source issue/spec review and local read-only audit, followed by a bounded CMake harness edit
method.limitations: Peer issue bodies are reporter-authored, version-specific evidence, not local reproductions or normative rules. No external DWG/DXF was downloaded or independently executed. Selected sample CTests returned from the converter-exit check before reaching the new terminal-EOF assertion.

sources.observed: Reports separate string framing/uninitialized tails, block traversal loss, wrong NOD selection, AcDs/SAB omission, unresolved TV/TU escape interpretation, and CMC ACI/RGB index handling. #1412 links fixes on mutable master but remains open; issue state is not tagged-release proof.

Reports cover aggregate INSERT-count confounding, LEADER annotation dimensions, ARC/ELLIPSE transform behavior, and a strict AutoCAD writer rejection attributed to CLASSES/HATCH/DIMSTYLE fields. These remain route/version-specific reports.

sources.revision: official HATCH boundary-path and ATTDEF tables reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: HATCH line-edge group 21 is the endpoint Y coordinate; ATTDEF group 2 is the attribute tag string. These references support local value classification but do not resolve unrelated HATCH group-47 or DIMSTYLE table-subclass writer claims.

sources.revision: current shared worktree inspected and focused harness edit made 2026-10-18
sources.observed: Existing generated controls cover zero HATCH line-edge Y, hash-bearing ATTDEF tags, embedded-MTEXT preservation/refusal, block-body ownership, NOD root ordering, and corrected CMC method distinctions. tests/run_dwg_read_test.cmake previously accepted any occurrence of EOF; it now requires terminal group-0 EOF after CRLF normalization.

existingOwnersRefined: PAR-49: require terminal group-0 EOF in the existing sample harness; retain required-section, complete-disposition, and truthful-status checks at composed gates
PAR-05/7AR: generated source-DWG TV/TU to one target-DXF characterization, field-scoped across ordinary text, MTEXT, and XRECORD
PAR-20/7G and PAR-49/7G: retain exact NOD root identity and BLOCK child-owner/body closure; aggregate counts do not prove either
S8/J256/J260/J268/J284/J293/J295: keep carrier, association, independent-read, and semantic-solid gates separate

implementationReadyChecks: Keep peer issue results tied to exact release/commit, operation, format version, and converter route.
Run the existing terminal-EOF sample CTest only after a selected sample conversion reaches the structural output checks; current selected samples stop earlier with dwg2dxf status 1.
Use generated source TV/TU controls and inspect original bytes, typed values, target DXF bytes, UTF-8 validity, field scope, and following-record alignment independently.
Do not resolve ACadSharp HATCH-47 or DIMSTYLE-header candidates without exact producer/version ordered tags and strict consumer acceptance.
Keep all six external-only J items deferred and non-promoting.

validation.cmakeTerminalEofRegexControl: PASS: space-padded group-0 EOF with CRLF accepted; EOF followed by another record rejected
